name: Zhao Haiying Law | 赵海英律师
description: 赵海英律师，兰台（上海）律师事务所。专注涉外继承、资金资产出境、跨境婚姻家事、涉外遗嘱与财富传承，服务海外华人、在华外籍人士和跨境家庭。Zhao Haiying is a Shanghai-based lawyer focused on cross-border inheritance, asset repatriation, international family law, wills and estate planning for overseas Chinese and international clients.
